mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 72 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School under a first quarter moon, and there are no visible ISS passes scheduled for our night sky.

The city reminds you to check out VHAT, the local public access channel, for government meetings. Also, please review the residential parking rules, which limit the number of vehicles allowed on a property and prohibit parking in front yards.
The week is packed with excitement including Trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie on July 21, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July 22, and free Concerts in the Park on July 23.
In a notable report from July 16, a driver was stopped for expired registration and was subsequently arrested for an outstanding warrant, resisting arrest, and drug possession charges.
You can look forward to the Chocolate Caramel Twist today, but since the shop is currently closed, make sure to head over when they open at 10 AM to get your fix.
